title: Boston Marathon Official Charity Program (BAA)
claims: The Bank of America Boston Marathon Official Charity Program provides invitational entries to selected non-profit organizations, which recruit athletes pledged to raise funds.
The 2027 Official Charity Program lists 215 member charities; the Letter of Interest window for organizations ran from 3 to 13 June 2026.
Charity selection criteria include being a registered 501(c)(3), non-religious and non-political, and focusing on building healthy communities.
